local lens / A quieter place to check your writing.LOCALHOST · V1.0

UNDER THE LENS

A local model.
A useful second look.

Local Lens can run two English-language classifiers: DistilBERT (default) and the experimental Qwen3-0.6B. Pick one above the editor. The downloaded model runs on your laptop's CPU. Inference cannot download files, and the page uses no analytics or external assets.

DistilBERT splits long documents into model-sized windows; the overall score is a token-weighted average, and highlighted passages are scored separately. Qwen3-0.6B scores the whole document in one pass and accepts at most 1,023 text tokens — longer input is rejected with the exact count, never truncated, and no passage highlights are computed for it.

Alongside the mean score, the stats show the AI-flagged share: the fraction of words inside passages that lean AI. A document can average low while a large part of it is flagged.

At or below 35% is labeled human-leaning, at or above 65% is AI-leaning, and the middle range is uncertain. These are display thresholds, not validated confidence levels; for the experimental model they are provisional. New generators, editing, language, and short samples can change reliability.

This is an independent local tool. Its scores do not reproduce Turnitin or the reference website. Your text lives only in memory unless you choose Save report.
